waText:
🌵 *This weekend in Tesoro Highlands*
Here's what to do this weekend in Tesoro Highlands and around Santa Clarita.

🌽 *Sat 8:30 AM* — Old Town Newhall Farmers Market (free)
   Fresh local produce, perfect for Saturday morning
🏛️ *Sat 10 AM* — Hart Mansion Group Tour 10:00a.m. (free)
   Free mansion tours all weekend, great for families
🎉 *Fri 9 PM* — Black Friday Thanksgiving Hangover Party! ($23.18–$55.20)
   Festive night out for adults looking to unwind
🥬 *Sun 8:30 AM* — Valencia FivePoint Farmers Market (free)
   Another farmers market option for Sunday shoppers
🎭 *Fri 8 PM* — It's a Wonderful Life ($25)
   Classic holiday show for families and older kids

Full list → https://tesorohighlands.com/events
